dialogues.title: Verification workflow

turns.finalText:
Verification is done by the organization responsible for the specific opportunity. They review the volunteer's evidence and confirm that the work was actually completed. You can learn more about these trustworthy experiences on the Verified Experiences page.

turns.finalText: The organization that posted the opportunity takes charge of reviewing the evidence you submit. This is their way of confirming that the work was actually done by you. When they verify your contribution, it becomes a Verified Experience on your public profile, which includes details like the activity, the organization, and the evidence you provided. If they approve it, they can even leave a review or add private notes for your reference. You can always use the unique verification code to prove your experience on the public verification page, ensuring it is trustworthy and authentic. For example, if you helped with an event, the organization checks your photos or reports before marking it as completed.
